9999.$description: Sentinel that always renders as a pill or circle; border-radius.full in each brand file is its only consumer.

sm.$description:
The sharp preset's button radius at size sm. Fixed across brand, viewport and theme — a brand changes its shape by pointing its border-radius.button.sm at another preset, never by editing this cell.

Used in:
border-radius.button.sm in any brand file on the sharp preset.

Do not:
Do not bind it directly — bind the brand's border-radius.button.sm.
